He felt proud to be part of something that helped others and protected the environment. His teacher said that being a global citizen means thinking about people and places around you. Adel realized that even young students can act with responsibility and kindness. He now encourages his friends to take care of the world.

questions.q: It's okay to try different things and learn from failure.
questions.passage: Planning your future career starts with knowing your talents and interests. It's okay to try different things and learn from failure. Education and training help you build the skills you need. Besides personal goals, it's also important to be a global citizen. This means thinking about how your actions affect the world. For example, reducing plastic helps protect oceans and marine animals. Being a global citizen also means respecting others, and helping with global problems like climate change. Making smart, responsible choices now can help create a better future for everyone.

questions.passage: Farida Osman is a famous Egyptian swimmer. She was born in 1995 in Cairo. Farida started swimming when she was five years old. She practices every day to become better. Farida is very fast in the water. She has won many medals in different tournaments around the world. In 2017, she won a bronze medal. This made her the first Egyptian woman to win a swimming medal at that level. Farida is an example for many young athletes in Egypt. She shows that with hard work, you can achieve great success. Farida loves her country and always wants to make Egypt proud. She dreams of winning more medals and helping other young swimmers to succeed.
